accepted.sentence: A central vertical partition can split the interior into narrower bays, supporting separate arrangements of stored objects.
Many designs have a shallow front-to-back depth, allowing them to fit along walls without projecting far into a room.
The top panel is usually broad and flat, forming an additional surface above the stacked storage levels.
A bottom plinth or short legs can lift the lowest panel above the floor and provide clearance for cleaning.
Fasteners such as dowels, screws, and cam connectors join panels at corners and help hold the frame together.
Edge banding may cover exposed cuts along panel edges, giving them a smoother finished perimeter.
Some frames include cross-bracing or diagonal tension hardware to resist side-to-side wobbling.
Continuous side panels can extend from base to top, enclosing each level laterally and defining the structure's overall height.
